The capability is retired rather than left as a permanent default-off: the enable paths no longer exist.

residualLimitations: The Settings > Developer VToken Bridge panel still exists and now reports a retired status; deleting it lives in src/components/settings/ which is outside TF-0496 allowed paths (TF-0505 owns surface cleanup).
The A/B covers the packing format on the p21 scenario corpus; it does not measure provider billing, only provider-reported usage tokens.
The first test attempt died before any provider call because the pair builder produced 26 of the predeclared 30 pairs; the builder was fixed deterministically before the single deciding run.
